decisions.reason: The source changes only the footer background from purple to dark gray; it does not change the shared dark page theme or its landing-page reference.
The client rejects purple only for the footer and does not revise the landing page's purple background direction or other visual choices.
Changing the footer background color does not alter the decision to omit navigation from the website header.
The source selects a footer color but does not change the required token-sheet format, token uses, type scale, spacing, radii, or border-width specification.
The footer color decision does not affect landing-page copy, section order, the How It Works sequence, or its sequence visual.
The policy destinations and their footer-menu access point remain unchanged by the footer background color.
The source explicitly concerns the website footer and does not change the Cognito sign-in page branding, background treatment, or required visual elements.
The informational-page shell currently requires a background and header logo; the footer-specific color change does not alter those shell elements.
The admin workspace footer is part of a separate SaaS UI shell, while the source changes the shared website footer only.
A footer background color change does not modify reusable responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The website footer color does not resolve or change the provisioning wizard's accent, derived values, layout variables, button states, or assets.
The footer's visual color change does not alter the selected plain HTML and Tailwind CSS build stack.
